_note: Authored training metadata for the five Task 10 pilot cases. Three fields per objective. `phase` is one of the coach's five spoiler-free phases and is all a tier-1 hint ever shows. `category` is one of the coach's nine fixed categories and is all a tier-2 hint ever shows; it names a system or a kind of action, never a finding. `step` is the explicit next step and is shown only when a learner asks a third time. `priority` is the order a clinician would work the case, which no phase label can express — on the septic patient the cultures precede the antibiotics. `notWhen` names coach-supplied run flags (__pulse, __arrest, __rosc) under which a step is contraindicated, so the coach cannot tell someone to start compressions on a child who still has a pulse.
_review: Every `step` line and every `priority` ordering is a clinical statement and needs Kim's review before this ships as taught content. The phases and categories are structural and are enforced against the module's own vocabulary by tests/training-coach.test.cjs.

sepsis.cultures-and-lactate.step: Send a lactate and both blood and urine cultures before the antibiotics go in.

sepsis.antibiotics.step: Broad-spectrum IV antibiotics, inside the first hour.

sepsis.source-control.step: Image for the source, and get urology to the phone.

sepsis.reassess-and-pressor.step: Reassess the perfusion after the fluid. If the MAP is still under 65, start noradrenaline.

sepsis.disposition.step: This patient needs an ICU bed.

ptx.needle.step: Decompress the chest now, before any film.

ptx.tube.step: A tube thoracostomy, after the needle.

ptx.reassess.step: Reassess the perfusion and the oxygenation now the chest is decompressed.

pea.epinephrine.step: Epinephrine 1 mg IV or IO, repeated every three to five minutes.

pea.airway.step: Ventilate, and confirm the airway with waveform capnography.

pea.decompress.step: Decompress the chest on the side the line attempt went in.

pea.definitive-tube.step: A definitive chest tube now there is a pulse, and a film to confirm its position.

pea.post-arrest.step: ICU, with a 12-lead and temperature management.

appy.supportive.step: Analgesia, IV fluids, and nil by mouth.

appy.labs.step: Labs, and a pregnancy test in a woman of reproductive age.

appy.imaging.step: Imaging: ultrasound first in a child or in pregnancy, CT in an uncertain adult.

pals.nebs.step: Continuous nebulised salbutamol with ipratropium, and high-flow oxygen.

pals.steroid-and-magnesium.step: A systemic steroid early, and magnesium sulfate.

pals.ventilation.step: Low rate, long expiratory time, and disconnect the circuit to let the chest deflate.

pals.decompress.step: Needle decompression, then a finger thoracostomy or a chest tube.

pals.compressions.step: Compressions, and the PEA algorithm, now the pulse is gone.

pals.epinephrine.step: Epinephrine 0.01 mg/kg, every three to five minutes.

pals.fluids.step: A 20 mL/kg fluid bolus for the obstructive shock.

pals.picu.step: Paediatric intensive care once there is ROSC.
